notes.title: Voice Control System Now Officially Released
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello, Air Traffic Controllers![/b][/p][p]The [b]Voice Control Mode[/b], which has been in testing for quite some time, is finally leaving beta and becoming an official feature! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/7733363bba0cf387c68b09d6aa1b86512143d61d.png"][/img][/p][p]Once the update goes live, you’ll be able to use voice commands on [b]all maps[/b] to guide your flights. ([i]Note: Since this mode relies on Windows’ built-in speech recognition, it will not support macOS or Linux.[/i])[/p][p]In Voice Control Mode, you can directly issue commands via your microphone in [b]Chinese or English[/b]. If recognition accuracy seems off, try training the Windows speech recognition system further in its settings.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/f29b39ec14a0189865529ea13bac4edae50c20a5.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]A Few Extra Words...[/b][/h3][p]We know many of you are excited about Voice Control, but we approach this update with some nervousness—[b]because honestly, we couldn’t add any extra features[/b] to this mode in past few months, and we couldn’t even port it to other operating systems. For a tiny team like ours, that proved simply too difficult.[/p][p]To get technical: [b]Our voice recognition relies on an external process (a supporting library),[/b] and adapting it across OSes comes with massive hurdles. For example, macOS has [b]complex permission policies[/b] for standalone processes, and the library itself [b]struggles with cross-platform compatibility[/b]. Our devs fought hard but couldn’t out-bug the issues that followed.[/p][p]We also looked into [b]cloud-based AI speech recognition[/b] (which is booming these days), but as a [b]one-time-purchase game[/b], recurring API costs for such a service simply weren’t sustainable for us.[/p][p]After months of effort, we confirmed—[b]this is the best version we can deliver right now.[/b] It's imperfect, but we’ll keep tracking tech advancements for better solutions. [b]If you have ideas or suggestions, we'd love to hear them![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Our main focus next will be on optimizing the mobile version and developing a new demo. As for the voice control feature, we'll come back to improve it in the future when either speech recognition technology sees new breakthroughs or our programmers gain enough technical expertise to overcome the current limitations.[/p][p][/p][p]Our social media channels:[/p][p][b]Official Discord: [/b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2FqUJ4G8pftv"]click in[/url]
[b]Official YouTube: [/b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F%40MiniAirways%2Fvideos"]click in[/url]
[b]Twitter: [/b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FNpaMiniAir"]click in[/url]

Happy flying!
CCC Games & Erabit Studios
[/p]

notes.title: Voice Mode Test is About to Begin! Get 22% Off on Mini Airways During the Spring
notes.content:
Hello, air traffic controllers!
First, we have some exciting news: Mini Airways will be available at a historic low discount of 22% during the Steam Spring Sale (March 13th to March 20th). The game will be priced under $7.8 after the discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/4657289fce66c44128d6ac037db677bebff7c663.jpg[/img]

Additionally, we are working on a cool new feature—Voice Mode! We believe that using voice commands to control flights, just like real air traffic controllers, will provide an extraordinary experience. Although there are some technical challenges, we are making continuous efforts to bring this feature to you.

Now, we can show you a part of the results. Simply right-click on Mini Airways in your Steam library – Properties – Betas – and select the [Beta] or [voicecontrolbeta] branch to update and be the first to experience the fun of voice-controlled flight management!
 (Please note that Voice Mode requires Windows' built-in voice recognition feature, so it is currently not supported on MacOS and Linux systems.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/b9ce3732a61c75d5d90417f9f33765001a6f7e0e.png[/img]

In Voice Control Mode, players can directly issue commands through a microphone, with support for both Chinese and English. During the testing phase, two maps—London City Airport（EGLC） and Shanghai Pudong Airport（ZSPD）—will be available. If you find the recognition accuracy is not ideal, you can try additional training in Windows settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/7733363bba0cf387c68b09d6aa1b86512143d61d.png[/img]

We are also improving the beginner's guide, and any feedback can be provided through our social media channels!

notes.title: Multiplayer Mode, Start! - Patch notes v0.10.2
notes.content:
Attention all air traffic controllers, we have just released a major version update! Here are the contents of this update:

[Update Contents]
1. Support for multiplayer online gameplay.
2. That's it. (Less text, bigger news!)

[Multiplayer Gameplay Instructions]
1. We have added an initial interface entry for the multiplayer mode, which will be visible after the update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/e00a660172205ba79f65a20e1420a73bb9a93427.png[/img]

2. After entering multiplayer mode, the game lobby will display all public online rooms and the current map being played. Players can choose to join a public room directly, enter a private room by entering the room code, or create your own room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/d00993195bd6d4759256d346511c7d5c8d25fc06.png[/img]

3. Online rooms support Creative Workshop maps, and members who join later do not need to download the workshop map to play.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/c2ad403cfb61268ae2fa3df58cb14a3cd51ad4ae.png[/img]

4. Usually, after joining a room, you need to click the ready button, and wait host to start the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/918a243234643a05f9b50a63b485b82896f52ea5.png[/img]

5. In online mode, you can view the current room code in the lower left corner of the interface, and your teammates' mouse pointers will appear as white dots. Planes in the map can be controlled by everyone, and in-game upgrades, game speed, and pause options are all controlled by the host.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/d71c6c3e3c54bfa5366bb62cdbdb3c1e41436483.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.8.2 - New Map, Borderless Window, Bug fixes
notes.content:
Air Traffic Controllers, we have just released our first update since the official game launch. In addition to adding a new map and the highly requested borderless window mode, we have also fixed several bugs reported since the game went live.

[New Content]
1. Added a new map: La Palma Airport.
2. Added a borderless window mode (Fullscreen Windowed in Options) for Windows. This mode helps prevent some issues caused by fullscreen mode.
3. Introduced Camera Offset functionality in the map editor.

[Bug Fixes]
1. Fixed an issue where the leaderboard would not refresh when switching modes.
2. Fixed an issue where the no-fly zone indicator would block the taxiing area on high-resolution screens.
3. Fixed a bug where Air Force One could collide with other aircraft off-screen.
4. Fixed issues leading to false Traffic alerts in certain scenarios.
5. Fixed an issue where scores over 999 would not display correctly.
